papers.title: RAN: A randomness-anchored watermark attacking network with stealth and effectiveness
limitations: Only two embedding schemes; traditional mean BER.240 does not establish random/chance decoding despite the randomness objective. WAM near-.5 mean BER is not calibrated image-level removal. Captions of Tables2--3 identify I_co versus I_a, while the metric definitions and narrative use I_w versus I_a: quality-reference conflict unresolved. Exact WAM checkpoint/native settings, random support/seeds, extractor-gradient handling and WAM-specific n are NR. No forensic stealth test; no F5 or independent-encoder transfer evidence; reported inference .022s on their setup is not a server cost estimate.
